halve.name: Blight
halve.desc: On a creature: every stat halved, whoever it belongs to. On bare ground: the tile is cursed, and the next creature to stand there arrives halved.

double.name: Gild
double.desc: On a creature: every stat doubled, whoever it belongs to. On bare ground: the tile is blessed, and the next creature to stand there arrives doubled.

cull.name: Cull
cull.desc: On a creature: it is destroyed where it stands, whoever it belongs to. On bare ground: a trap, and the next creature to stand there dies at once.

swap.name: Displace
swap.desc: Pick a creature, then a second tile: the two trade places, gear and curses included. The second tile may be bare ground, and the creature simply walks to it.

ward.name: Ward
ward.desc: On a creature: it takes every drawn stat in the clash. On bare ground: the tile is shut to your opponent for their next turn.
